A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new scheme for video object segmentation, in which the 3D structure tensors are used to extract the spatial-constrained VO motion masks without dense motion field computation.
a novel scheme is developed to generate motion masks by using the 3D structure tensors and the proposed rigidity analysis.
the proposed scheme can effectively segment moving objects in videos without computing dense motion fields, and can handle both rigid and nonrigid motions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
3D structure tensors can be exploited for automatic VO segmentation without dense motion field computation.
, by generating motion masks with scale-adaptive spatiotemporal filtering, VO segmentation is made automatic, and the computation cost is greatly reduced.
, the proposed scheme can effectively segment moving objects from video sequences without computing dense motion fields, and thus can be used in real-time VO segmentation applications.
